mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Ridge Middle School with a Waning Gibbous moon, and we are looking at an overnight low of 52 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona Plan Commission has several active projects on their agenda for the upcoming October 5th meeting, including site plans for 201 South Main Street and various certified survey maps for the Town of Verona.

We have a busy week ahead, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a variety of trivia nights and live music performances at local spots like Paddy Mac's and Lake Lou-ee starting tomorrow.

In a report covering September 14th through September 28th, officers were dispatched on September 24th to a vehicle collision involving an 11-year-old bicyclist, who was fortunately evaluated by EMS and did not require hospitalization.

Today's flavor of the day was Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. As we are currently closed for the night, we invite you to stop by tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM to enjoy our delicious Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
